FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Brambleford Gas Pipelines Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Field operator
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Just got a call from Jess at the Saint John station. She was doing the morning rounds and SCADA
popped a pressure alarm at 06:40. Reading was 6,550 kPa, MOP is 6,000. She walked the pump
bay, didn't see any product on the ground or dripping. Shut the unit down, pressure dropped
back to line pack. Pump housing looks okay, no visible cracks or leaks. Contractor ops tech was
there on shift, said he'd checked the seals at midnight and everything was tight. Jess is going to
pull the pressure chart and log it. That's all we know right now.
- Raj, Field Ops On-call
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
